notes.title: 3DCoat Modding Tool Update
notes.notes:
Good day, modders! 

If you could notice, we have an update to the 3DCoat Modding Tool, uploaded recently. 
Folllowing multiple requests, we have updated the RUST items support within the application, since many of those have been incompatible for a while. 

Please, check out the update and let us know what you think.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Rust Intergation Ready & Available Now!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the work on integrating the [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/252490/Rust/]Rust[/url][/b] support in 3DCoat Modding Tool has been finalized!

Download the 10-day demo for free to test it or buy the release version of 3DCoat Modding Tool to start creating your own skins of Rust's in-game items now. 

Just the same way it already works with CS:GO, in case of Rust we have simplified the skin creation experience for you as much as possible. We have automated the importing of in-game models with all the related parts, layers and textures into the 3DCoat editor, assembling a proper scene  - so all you need to do is just design a skin and press the export button to get it properly packed and ready for Steam Workshop. 

We have pre-composed the scenes with models and textures from the game.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31913075/a854c40828031ab78d999126d46a2ab6a2602f5f.jpg[/img]
Normally you would download it all from Rust UI, combine the model and textures manually. But with our Modding Tool you get the ready scenes with all the textures applied to the model. That allows you to start modding easily without any hassle and manual pre-composing. 

Therefore, all you need to do is just the creative part. So, enjoy and feel free to share your experience with 3DCoat Modding Tool!

notes.title: Working on support for RUST as we speak
notes.notes:
Good news! Based on your multiple requests and the permission received from the Facepunch Studios, we're implementing the support for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/252490/Rust/]RUST[/url] within the 3DCoat Modding Tool. 
Here's a couple early screens of how it's coming along so far: 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31913075/d847b5f23b23d037b9f6cb1569561c227ee6f4dd.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31913075/675650013ea0a90933c5fd415b337b3ded2d8516.png[/img]
Stay tuned for more news coming soon!

notes.title: 3DCoat Modding Tool Demo Is Available Now!
notes.notes:
Yeah, now you can download and try out the 3DCoat Modding Tool and see how fun it is before you buy! 

The demo provides you with a fully functional Modding Tool for 10 consequtive days. So don't hesitate to download and check it out for free! 

Hit the Download Demo button to the right of the Add to Cart one and have fun! 

Don't forget to let us know your impressions after.

notes.title: 3DCoat Modding Tool is Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hooray, we got 3DCoat Modding Tool out on Steam now! 

We hope it will come very handy for your skins creations. Let us know what you think of it so far. We need your feedback on how the tools perform and whether you are happy with 3DCoat Modding Tool overall. 
Also, make sure to leave your comments as to which other games you'd like to see supported in our modding tool! 

Have fun modding and stay tuned for more news coming soon!
